create_agent: create a new agent via POST /v1/agents with agent name, card params, and LiteLLM configuration
get_agents: get a list of all registered agents with optional health check filtering
get_agent_by_id: get a specific agent by its unique agent ID from the agent registry
update_agent: update an existing agent's configuration via PUT /v1/agents/{agent_id}
delete_agent: delete an agent by its ID from both the database and in-memory registry
